data.exact_reserve_text: Net claims (strengthening)/release for prior accident years was a release of GBP 22,690,000. Additionally, the revision of the Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% resulted in a gross strengthening of claims outstanding by GBP 155,750,000, applied to the 31 December 2016 valuation.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Revision of the Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% applied to long-tail motor liabilities existing at 31 December 2016, causing a gross strengthening of claims outstanding.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall strengthening in prior year reserves of GBP 133.06 million. This was primarily driven by a gross strengthening of GBP 155.75 million due to the revision of the Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75%, applied to long-tail motor liabilities existing at the 2016 year-end. This adverse impact was partially offset by a pre-Ogden gross release of GBP 22.69 million from prior accident years' claims provisions.
raw_causal_phrases: Revision of Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% Change in claims outstanding - gross (155,750)
The movements in 2016 have been affected by the change in the Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% causing deteriorations in the gross position.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure combines the explicit movement from the 'Movement in prior accident year's provision' note with the gross impact of the Ogden discount rate change, which was a subsequent event applied to the 2016 valuation. The claims development triangle on page 10 is presented in thousands (GBP 000).
